#+TITLE: org-plot radar charts

The first table is the Org manual's radar example.

#+PLOT: title:"An evaluation of plaintext document formats" transpose:yes type:radar min:0 max:4
| Format            | Fine-tuned-control | Initial Effort | Syntax simplicity | Editor Support | Integrations | Ease-of-referencing | Versatility |
|-------------------+--------------------+----------------+-------------------+----------------+--------------+---------------------+-------------|
| Word              |                  2 |              4 |                 4 |              2 |            3 |                   2 |           2 |
| LaTeX             |                  4 |              1 |                 1 |              3 |            2 |                   4 |           3 |
| Org Mode          |                  4 |              2 |               3.5 |              1 |            4 |                   4 |           4 |
| Markdown          |                  1 |              3 |                 3 |              4 |            3 |                   3 |           1 |
| Markdown + Pandoc |                2.5 |              3 |                 3 |              4 |            3 |                   3 |           3 |

Without bounds, each axis gets its own rounded range and org-plot picks the
tick count from the ranges.

#+PLOT: type:radar
| Skill   | Ana | Ben |
|---------+-----+-----|
| Speed   |  12 |  30 |
| Power   | 120 |  95 |
| Range   | 3.5 | 1.2 |
| Stamina |  70 |  40 |

#+PLOT: type:radar ticks:5 max:10
| Axis | A | B |
|------+---+---|
| x    | 2 | 8 |
| y    | 6 | 3 |
| z    | 9 | 5 |
